1. "id": the result of (27 times 4) plus 85 — as a number, not a string

3. "tags": exactly these 5 strings sorted in REVERSE alphabetical (Z to A) order: "brick", "delta", "flint", "cedar", "grove"

Any extra key, wrong type, wrong order inside "tags", wrong nesting, or wrong casing counts as a mistake.
